# HypergraphMeanFieldApproximation

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted

## Definition
A mathematical technique reducing hypergraph dynamics to averaged equations over node states, assuming homogeneous group interactions. Provides tractable analytical models for predicting emergent behavior in large-scale TCC/iNEST systems, enabling scalable design and optimization.
